name: ItemMeta
lead: The extras an item table may carry: count, name, lore, colours, glint, a canvas map, a pack item id, wear, a 1.21.4+ model and a head's skin.

fields.name: count
fields.description: How many in the stack; 1 by default.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Never italic unless it says so.

fields.name: lore
fields.description: One line or a list of lines, grey unless they say otherwise.

fields.name: color
fields.description: A potion's liquid colour; 1.11 and later.

fields.name: glint
fields.description: The enchanted shine, with no enchantment.

fields.name: canvas
fields.description: A filled map of that canvas: what the item *is*, so `item` may be left out. Everywhere an item is taken — a hand, a hotbar slot, a display.

fields.name: id
fields.description: A pack's own item: a brick with `id = "copper_ingot"` is a copper ingot, kept under the pack's name and known by it everywhere it goes.

fields.name: damage
fields.description: The wear a tool has taken; 0 is new.

fields.name: model
fields.description: The item model a 1.21.4+ client draws: `assets/<pack>/items/<model>.json`.

fields.name: skin
fields.description: The face a "player_head" item shows: a player's name, or the raw `textures` property. On any other item it is an error.
